card: Create ONE production UI sprite sheet for Dream & Nightmare's 2D roguelike map choice cards, landscape 3:2, true transparent background. Exactly three isolated cutouts, with clear transparent gutters and generous outer padding. Use this precise layout so the sprites can be sliced: left half contains a single tall upright frame centered at x=26%, y=50%; right half contains a single horizontal title plate centered at x=74%, y=27%, and a single tiny crossed-swords battle symbol centered at x=74%, y=72%. No asset may cross the vertical midline; the two right sprites must be separated by a clear empty horizontal strip. The tall frame's outer silhouette is width:height 360:440, close to rectangular, with a thin aged silver border and tiny corner ornaments. The large open interior of this frame is completely transparent, because art and text will be drawn beneath it. The horizontal nameplate is a dark indigo slate plaque, around 5:1 aspect, with a thin pewter edge and a blank, calm, opaque center for later text. The crossed swords are a bold, compact silvery pictogram, with short handles and enough contrast to read at 24 px. Shared art direction: sober dark fantasy, worn silver and navy blue, hand-painted yet crisp game UI, understated medieval ironwork, minimal highlights. Orthographic front view, crisp readable silhouettes. No characters, lettering, words, numerals, labels, labels on cutouts, watermark, UI mockup or background. Isolated transparent outside areas and frame center, no connecting shadows or glows between cutouts.
